purpose: Replace Task14's native L11H3 base-term-plus-displacement execution with ten direction-by-cardinality absolute head terms exported from the second corpus and tested under a new intervention on the third corpus.

prior_art_search.result: The selected Task14 program exports ten displacements and always adds one to a context-specific native base head. No prior receipt exports cardinality-conditioned absolute L11H3 heads or tests whether the local native base term can be omitted.

construction: On the second corpus, average the exact post-YZ L11H3 final-position head separately by answer direction and background cardinality. On every third-corpus row and background subset, install the corresponding absolute head directly, without reading or adding the recipient base head. Compare its effect against the immutable exact native displacement effect.

predictions.pred_a_immutable_export_and_instrument: Exactly ten finite 1,152-D absolute heads are exported with the registered direction/cardinality support; source and downstream closure errors are at most 1e-4 and the immutable third-corpus capability/validation remains passing.
predictions.pred_b_absolute_head_substitutes_exact_e: Across all 512 third-corpus cells, absolute-head effects reproduce immutable native exact effects at cosine at least 0.75, relative L2 at most 0.75, norm ratio 0.25 to 2.0, and sign agreement at least 0.75.
predictions.pred_c_each_direction_template_and_cardi: Every direction-by-template cell has cosine at least 0.65 and sign agreement at least 0.65; every cardinality has cosine at least 0.65 and sign agreement at least 0.65.
predictions.pred_d_native_l11h3_base_dependency_remo: The absolute replacement never reads the third-corpus native L11H3 base head. This removes only that patched local term; native execution to construct all other context and the downstream suffix remain required.
predictions.pred_e_fixed_price: Export plus validation uses six physical forwards, 1,216 example evaluations, 1,024 causal installations, ten stored vectors (11,520 FP32 scalars), and zero fits, backwards, or updates.

terminal_rule: program_screen if all gates pass; null if immutable inputs are valid but absolute transfer fails; invalid on hash, support, closure, join, or price mismatch.
closed_claims: native suffix replacement for causal execution
